title: fix: reduce community publishing delay
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reduces the community model publication and price-change delay from 12 hours to 3 hours
- Applies the same delay to owner relisting and endpoint agents
- Updates API/UI/monitor wording and focused assertions

Tests: exact 3-hour constant assertion passes; 16/18 wider focused tests passed locally, with two unchanged error-path tests blocked by unavailable local Tinybird error ingestion.

gist.headline: The garden updates faster
gist.blurb: Community models no longer spend half a day staring at the pot before they are allowed outside. Publishing, price updates, relisting, and endpoint agents now move on a three-hour rhythm.
gist.summary: Reduced the community endpoint publication and price-change delay from 12 hours to 3 hours, with the same 3-hour window applied to owner relisting and endpoint agents across the API, UI, and monitor.
gist.impact: Community model owners can publish, update pricing, relist endpoints, and use endpoint agents up to 9 hours sooner while seeing consistent three-hour timing everywhere.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy community model garden where a large retro clock has been adjusted from 12 hours to 3 hours and model-seed packets can reach a glowing API endpoint sooner. Polli, wearing a tiny gardener's hat and holding a clock key, helps a small CRT monitor robot place freshly bloomed code-plants onto a community shelf; lime green status lights and flowers make the faster publishing cycle visible.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art community garden workshop where the cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings wears a tiny gardener hat and turns a retro clock from “12H” to “3H”; beside her, a chunky CRT-monitor robot carefully shelves blooming code-plants labeled “PUBLISH” and “PRICE.” Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm cream workspace, pixel flowers and vines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle CRT glow and the pixel-font text “3 HOURS.” Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
